rules: not operationalisable: Needs footprint / market-delta (aggressor-signed volume) data. The certified XAUUSD M1 file has only open/high/low/close (no volume column at all) and OANDA spot gold is an OTC quote stream with no exchange tape, so delta and its divergence from price cannot be computed; an OHLC proxy would test a different indicator. The speaker also states he does not really use delta himself.
